const helpText = `❓ WEATHER BUDDY HELP

Here's what I can do:
🌤️ Current weather: "Weather in Lagos"
📅 Forecasts: "Tomorrow in Abuja" or "Next 3 days in Kano" (up to 15 days ahead)
🌧️ Rain checks: "Will I need an umbrella in Port Harcourt tomorrow?"
🔀 Comparisons: "Is Lagos hotter than Port Harcourt?"
💬 Follow-ups: after a city, just ask "What about tomorrow?"
📍 Location: tap 📎, choose Location, and send it (optional)

Tips:
• Add the country when a name is shared (London, Canada).
• For a Nigerian state, send the state name or its capital.
• I remember the last place you checked for up to 24 hours so follow-ups work.

Commands: /start /help`;

const { kind, chatId, firstName } = $input.first().json;
const welcome = `👋 Hey ${firstName}! Welcome to Weather Buddy! 🌤️💙

I'm your friendly weather companion. I can help you check current weather, explore forecasts, and plan your day.

🌍 You can:
🌤️ Check the current weather
📅 Get tomorrow's forecast
🌧️ Check the chance of rain
📍 Share your location
💬 Ask me a weather question naturally

Which city or location shall we check first? 😊`;
return [{ json: { chatId, reply: kind === 'start' ? welcome : helpText } }];
